data.name: Acid Spray
data.description: A nyogoth's body is full of highly corrosive digestive fluid.  Every time a nyogoth is damaged by a piercing or slashing weapon, all creatures adjacent to the nyogoth take 1d6 points of acid damage (2d6 acid damage if the attack is a critical hit).
